interfaces.name: measured
interfaces.constraints: Finite nonnegative float64 vector (N,) in caller-defined uncertainty units. Empty vectors allowed.

interfaces.name: driver
interfaces.constraints: Finite signed float64 vector (N,), exactly aligned with measured. Coefficients convert driver units to measured units.

interfaces.name: driver_scale
interfaces.constraints: Explicit finite nonnegative real scalar; booleans rejected. First multiplication is driver times driver_scale.

interfaces.name: component_scale
interfaces.constraints: Explicit finite nonnegative real scalar; booleans rejected. Applied after driver_scale; empirical values belong to the recipe.

interfaces.name: result
interfaces.constraints: Float64 vector sqrt(measured**2 + ((driver*driver_scale)*component_scale)**2). Independent components assumed by caller; nonfinite intermediate or output rejects.

providers.operation: Combine independent measured uncertainty and an explicitly scaled driver in quadrature, preserving multiplication order.
providers.plain_description: Combine two independent sources of uncertainty using caller-supplied scales.

interfaces.name: points
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 (N,3) positions sharing origin and length unit with reference. Nonzero finite radial normalization required; empty batches allowed.

interfaces.name: reference
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 (N,3), exactly aligned with points. Displacement is points minus reference; no broadcasting.

interfaces.name: polar
interfaces.constraints: Signed length projected onto sign(z) times the increasing-colatitude basis. Zero at z=0; not an angular displacement. Nonfinite arithmetic rejects.

interfaces.name: azimuth
interfaces.constraints: Signed length along increasing azimuth about the z axis. Axis positions reject. Empty inputs return empty vectors.

providers.operation: Project Cartesian point-minus-reference residuals onto hemisphere-oriented polar and azimuthal directions.
providers.plain_description: Measure the difference between two positions along two local directions.

limitations: Automated Tier3 qualification only; no human Tier1 or usage-qualified Tier2 designation.
Finite float64 arrays only; aligned shapes without broadcasting. Empty batches are supported.
Projection outputs signed lengths, not angles. Caller supplies a common coordinate origin and units.
Polar basis is sign(z) times increasing colatitude, and is zero at z=0. Axis positions and nonfinite radial normalization reject.
Uncertainty assumes independent components; measured uncertainty is nonnegative and driver may be signed. Coefficients are explicit finite nonnegative real scalars.
Source arithmetic order is preserved. Nonfinite intermediates reject; underflow and finite rounding error are not exhaustively bounded.
No detector geometry, empirical coefficients, calibration maps or identifier policy is embedded.
Concrete witness rejects abstract execution; no symbolic proof is claimed.
Qualification runs serially with native threads bounded to one; callers own aggregate concurrency.
Installed RECORD checks validate current dependency files, not publisher authentication or clean deployment on other platforms.
Synthetic numerical and lifecycle evidence does not establish historical competition accuracy. Original CDG publication remains separate.
